objective: Distinguish duration, source/deployment observation mismatch, proxy-loss dependence, history, and online gradient/parameterization limits.

scope.baseline_exception: C/G and BN_RESET_G1 update only their registered BN affine parameters
scope.source_splits: reuse exact Screen24 fit/cal/val; source-val is a selection set
scope.source_prepare: reuse verified source-only oracle/basis/scaler artifacts, no full new oracle bank

training.STATIC: independently trained; reset state before every image
training.A_settings: Screen24 A32 amplitude 0.3; reuse exact frozen basis/scaler
training.B_settings: Screen24 B64 amplitude 0.3; reuse exact observer/aux/basis/scaler settings, bind actual config rather than infer from short name
training.LEGACY: observe styled support, commit support state, predict distinct styled query; unchanged fit auxiliary losses
training.SELF: observe current styled query and predict same query; retain LEGACY auxiliary losses; A clean reference changes to same query
training.SELF_TASK: same SELF recurrence; fit loss only original OD/OC-balanced seg_loss; auxiliary losses removed, calibration protocol remains matched
training.MLP_SELF: observe current query and predict same query, no persistent adaptation state; matched current MLP architecture
training.calibration_protocol: same per-method Screen24 calibration, checkpoint-isolated; PRECAL is a separate diagnostic

selection.evaluation: 64 source-val episodes (16 per frozen curriculum type), 32 visits each, deployment-aligned observe/predict current image; record soft and hard Dice
selection.checkpoint_per_model: maximize score over [4k,8k,12k,16k], tie within 1e-8 choose earlier
selection.A_B_recipe: per route maximize mean selected FULL/STATIC score over first two source seeds; tie LEGACY,SELF,SELF_TASK
selection.MLP_confirmation: MLP_SELF fixed, not selected by target performance
selection.confirmation_freeze: freeze route recipe before any target scores from this R9 round are unsealed; no recipe reselection on added seeds
selection.final_16k: report fixed final checkpoint separately, run only distinct bindings; maximum 161 slots

diagnostics.scale_definition: multiply FiLM residual at output by alpha; do NOT rescale stored latent or alter its transition
diagnostics.alpha_0_1: reuse C0/original only after exact-path identity; no target label selection
diagnostics.PRECAL: same fitted FULL task modules, A tau=1 / B kappa=1; preserve all other settings

gradient.calibration: 64 fixed source-cal 4-visit episodes per arm/LR; maximize same balanced hard-Dice score, tie lower LR; no target tuning
gradient.latent_scale: same R8 fit-oracle scale convention, float64, floor 1e-3, bound by artifact digest
gradient.loss: mean BCEWithLogits to detached six-view C0 soft target + 0.01*mean((u-u0)^2)
gradient.teacher: unmodulated current-statistics network; same six geometry views, inverse align and average; reuse observer original zero pass
gradient.strong_view: same pinned R8/GraTa augmentation and normalization path; no donor images
gradient.optimizer: fresh per-image Adam, betas .9/.999, eps1e-8, wd0

BN_RESET_G1.parameters: all registered BN affine only, restored from source per visit
BN_RESET_G1.loss: same mean BCE to C0 six-view target; standardized proximity term starts at zero and has zero gradient at sole first step

stress.MIXED: single SHA256(R9_MIXED_V1|registration_digest|content_identity) sort of registered 1951 arrivals, tie frozen manifest index, same for all
stress.LONG10: ten concatenated order0 streams; no within-trajectory reset; retain per-cycle outputs and independent visit IDs
stress.methods: five selected source variants + VPTTA/C/G + N/C0

resources.gpu_ids: resolve afresh; do not inherit 5/6/7 authorization
resources.profile_before_launch: profile source fit/validation/gradient/scoring/io; prove expanded matrix fits before binding
resources.reserve_policy: account completed work and authorized recovery; failed reservations reported separately from measured usage
resources.recovery: at most one equivalent-snapshot infrastructure recovery per job, retain failed record; no NaN repair/reseed or silent budget shrink
resources.score_decrease: finish all preregistered finite variants, do not stop or expand based on target scores

metrics.primary: equal mean four domains, OD/OC, orders0/1, source seed means
secondary: ASSD common finite counts and undefined
metrics.paired_units: same content, method, order and source seed; baseline seed ordinal pairing descriptive only
metrics.assd: OD/OC separate; keep undefined, no zero imputation or false significance
metrics.positive_research_signal: mean gain >=0.5 pp vs both matched C0 and VPTTA, >=4/5 positive seed means; illustrative research target, not early stop or statistical guarantee
metrics.history_claim: requires benefit over matched independently trained STATIC and same-weight RESET, with tails/OC checked
